q: Can I use hyaluronic acid serum every day?
a: Yes. This serum is made for daily use, morning and evening. Apply 3-4 drops to clean, damp skin and follow with moisturizer to help keep that hydrated feel.

q: Is hyaluronic acid serum good for sensitive skin?
a: The formula is built around hyaluronic acid, Pro-Vitamin B5 and Aloe Vera, which are known for a comfortable, soothing feel. Every skin is different, so if yours is reactive we suggest a patch test on the inner arm before using it on your face.

q: Can I use hyaluronic acid with vitamin C or retinol?
a: Yes, it layers well with both. Use a vitamin C serum in the morning before this one, and apply this serum after retinol in the evening for a more comfortable feel. We suggest keeping vitamin C and retinol in separate routines.

q: Do I need a moisturizer after hyaluronic acid serum?
a: We recommend it. Hyaluronic acid draws moisture to the skin surface, and a moisturizer on top helps hold that hydration in so skin stays soft and supple for longer.

q: Is this serum safe to use during pregnancy?
a: The serum contains hyaluronic acid, panthenol, vitamin E and botanical extracts, and no retinol or exfoliating acids. Because every pregnancy is different, please check the full ingredient list with your doctor before use.
